title: "Analyzing US Census Data"

execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(
    mean_median_household_income = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_margin_of_error = mean(moe, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
